title: Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship
program_type: University-level merit and need-based Master's scholarship administered per faculty/school
description: The Erasmus Trustfonds Scholarship is a full-time first-year Master's award from the Erasmus School of Economics worth up to EUR 17,500 for 2026-2027, combining a tuition fee waiver, a EUR 1,200 monthly living allowance and a one-off EUR 249 personal allowance. It is limited to three named ESE Master's programmes and to applicants who have never before been enrolled as a full degree Master student in the Netherlands. Applications for 2026-2027 are closed and outcomes were communicated by 13 March 2026.

title: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships
program_type: Excellence scholarship for incoming MSc students, funded by the Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence foundation
description: The Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships are financed by the legacy of Justus and Louise van Effen, who studied at TU Delft in the 1940s and believed technological developments would contribute to solving societal issues. Awarded students receive full tuition fees per year for a TU Delft MSc programme based on the statutory or institutional rate according to registered nationality, plus a contribution for living expenses.
